checks: Battery + Wire combines from the right HUD, consumes one of each and returns to the scene without Manage or a dropdown
Lighter + fluid refills the reusable lighter directly from the HUD
Weapon + its ammunition loads the selected weapon without opening inventory
A stabilizer can be applied to a selected firearm directly; the old inventory modal stays closed
An incompatible pair never consumes resources and has an explicit cancel action
A full pack rolls both ingredient counts back when neither stack frees an output slot
An unused key can be left in the room with confirmation; useful/spent classification remains truthful and discarding closes the dialog without opening the inventory
Dead players cannot heal, recharge, craft, refill or discard through any inventory entrypoint, even if another caller changes HP
First Wire Spool acquisition explains its battery use in Thoughts
A direct Recharge action uses the selected supply and leaves the room visible
Three added painted Storage boxes open in non-safe rooms and share stored equipment across the route
Selected item names and controls fit desktop, tablet and narrow mouse/touch HUD widths without icon/text overlap
